answers.question: How do cell tower records place Vance at Pier 9?
answers.text: Cellular dump records from Tower 4 show that Vance's phone pinged at Pier 9 at 10:14 PM. That places the phone there, not Vance directly, and it contradicts his sworn claim that he never left the Westside Diner between 9:30 and 11:00 PM. The narrator hasn't yet explained how the phone was tied to him.

answers.question: Why does the timing of the severed cameras matter for Vance's alibi?
answers.text: Vance swore he stayed at the Westside Diner from 9:30 to 11:00 PM, but the narrator says his phone pinged at Pier 9 at 10:14 PM, inside that window. The narrator then says this placed him on the pier moments before the harbor cameras were deliberately severed, so the cut timing ties him to the pier when the cameras went dark. The episode hasn't said what footage the cameras would have shown, so that part is still open.

answers.question: What did detectives find in Vance's waterfront locker?
answers.text: The narration only says that detectives uncovered something inside Vance's waterfront locker at midnight and that it "changes the motive entirely." It doesn't say what they found yet, so I can't tell you from what's been shown so far.
